claim: Hybrid retrieval–accumulation memory architectures outperform pure retrieval and accumulation-only designs in multi-agent LLM systems, especially for multi-hop and event-centric queries.
falsifier: Compare AR and TTL scores of hybrid, retrieval, and accumulation memory architectures on multi-hop and event-centric query tasks; the claim predicts that hybrid designs will achieve higher scores than pure designs.

exclusions: limited to the reported frameworks, tasks, and context window sizes; transfer beyond them is unestablished

title: Memory architecture–performance principle
